name: Respecting Women
overview: Scripture teaches that both men and women are created in the image of God, affirming the inherent dignity of women (Genesis 1:27). Women are honored for their strength, virtue, and honorable character, as exemplified in Proverbs 31, where a virtuous woman is described as invaluable and clothed with strength and honor (Proverbs 31:10, 17, 25, 29). Furthermore, in Christ, distinctions such as male and female are transcended, emphasizing unity and equal standing before God (Galatians 3:28). This foundation calls believers to respect and value women according to God's design and purpose.
